senses.example: Me da vergüenza hablar delante de todos.
senses.exampleGloss: I am embarrassed to speak in front of everyone.

alternatives.reason: A personality trait rather than the feeling of the moment.
Stronger and about a public moment.

notes: dar vergüenza is the fixed pattern: me da vergüenza. ¡Qué vergüenza! works for both shame and embarrassment.
